notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33531695/7444eb95374ced02f8d3c430def6329f36420cef.png

Fix List:


    A Few Giant Monsters were falling off the ground due to it's massive size and players have been getting stuck in Boss area with blue wall. It's now FIXED! You will no longer get stuck in Boss Areas!
    An invisible wall that blocks a stair into Boss Area in "Ancient Dungeon" is now removed!
    Other minor bug fixes that our developers have found.


Please report to us if you encounter any bugs or problems with the game. We will fix it within 1-3 days/usually we upload the reported bug's fix in next 6 hours/ depending on the problem. We care about bug reports and suggestions with the game, so please do not hesitate to contact us via discord, discussion board, community group chat or our customer support email. Thank you!

Discord: https://discord.gg/U9smhdX
Customer Support Email: aceofprime@gmail.com

notes.title: New Feature & Bug Fix
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33531695/2f0c02011b7a0f54b9c693901ee1e868eba8784d.png

Lock System

Now you can lock a closest enemy to cursor with Left Alt/you can change the key at Keybinding option/. It will exit the lock mode if you press "Left Alt" again. If your Walk Key is configured with "Left Alt", please change the key of a lock target button or walk button. It will not work if keys overlap each other.

Shrine Bug

We still receive bug reports on shrines from a few players even though we fixed the locations of it. So we did a different approach on shrine's code. Now you should no longer have any troubles with shrines again.
